1879097888.name: Black Speech
1879097888.desc: You spew foul words in the forgotten and vile language of Lugbûrz. The conviction and terror inherent in this speech weakens the heart of your enemy.

conditionalEffects.description: Your shouts have a chance to apply Clinging Fear to your target. Your melee skills will capitalize on this fear, turning it into the Unrelenting Curses DoT effect.

1879115296.name: Eldar's Cut
1879115296.desc: A close range attack.  This attack will knock down the opponent.

1879135904.name: Javelin of Deadly Force
1879135904.desc:
With preparation, some Wardens can throw their javelins with such deadly force that it will pass completely through several bodies.

For every target hit, you gain a stack of a Ranged Damage and Critical Damage buff.

With the appropriate Assailment traits, this javelin will apply the Marked and Diminished Target debuffs to any targets hit.
This skill is not influenced by modifiers to Max Range.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879139744.name: Feast
1879139744.desc: Upon defeating an opponent, you drink deeply, absorbing their morale.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a Defeat Response</rgb>

1879176352.name: Improved Do Not Fall This Day
1879176352.desc: You have foreseen that your ally will not fall this day. For the remainder of combat, if the target of this skill is defeated, they will be revived.

1879209888.name: Steed of the Warden
1879209888.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the warden.

1879241632.name: Call of the Eorlingas
1879241632.desc: The Eorlingas can use the power of voice to calm or harm their enemies.

1879266848.name: Merciful Fist
1879266848.desc: This powerful attack is Lothrandir's strongest unarmed strike.

1879277984.name: Concession and Rebuttal: Sustaining Bolt
1879277984.desc: A rune-keeper knows that a storm's energy is capable of feeding itself.\n\nThis skill is stronger when used at greater Battle Attunement.

1879288480.name: Ambush of Light
1879288480.desc: When given time to prepare, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879305760.name: Black-foot Chicken
1879305760.desc: Summons a black-foot chicken to brighten your day.

1879313696.name: Spirit Bear
1879313696.desc: Summons a spirit bear to brighten your day and be unsettling.

1879354400.name: Determination
1879354400.desc: Samwise Gamgee has come to rescue Frodo, and no Orc or evil shall keep him from his master.

1879363360.name: Quickened Inner Flame
1879363360.desc: Use Power to heal Morale for both yourself and your companion.\n\nMust have a companion summoned.

1879406752.name: Red Carrying Chicken
1879406752.desc: Carry around your prized red chicken.

1879411744.name: Cask-laden Donkey
1879411744.desc: Summons a hard-working donkey with portable refreshment.

1879415712.name: Portent of Deftness
1879415712.desc: A quick burst of defence, absorbing a portion of damage dealt to you.

1879418656.name: Call Prince Ingór
1879418656.desc: Blow the horn to summon Prince Ingór to your side.

1879457568.name: Restorative Shield-work
1879457568.desc: Briefly improve your defences, restoring morale each second if an enemy attack hits you. This effect lasts for 10 seconds or until you heal 5 times.

1879466272.name: Sail to Tharbad
1879466272.desc: Navigate to Tharbad with nearby fellows.

1879467808.name: Nature's Wrath
1879467808.desc: You maul the enemy with a furious attack, gaining Wrath.

procEffects.description: Bestial Fury: \n Whenever you Critically Hit with skills you gain:
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.
Vexation: \n Upon taking damage in Man form (20% chance in bear form):
Evading an attack applies an Incoming Healing bonus to you. This can only trigger once every 12 seconds.
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.

1879488032.name: Friend of the Wilds (Lantern-guardian)
1879488032.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879490720.name: Shadow Spider
1879490720.desc: Summons a shadowy spider to accompany you on your travels.

1879501344.name: Muster at Utug-bûr
1879501344.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to the Temple of Utug-bûr, in the far reaches of Urash Dâr in the Ikorbân Valley.

1879502752.name: Tea Time of the Sands
1879502752.desc: Place down a tea set bauble to share with friends.

1879517984.name: Strength
1879517984.desc: Strike your enemies with the certainty and strength of an Ent.

1879521312.name: Shade-born Zizanu
1879521312.desc: Summons a helpful shade-born zizanu to accompany you on your travels.

1879522080.name: Plant a Patch of: Tulips
1879522080.desc: Plant some seeds and make a lovely patch of tulips.

1879529504.name: Golden Stag
1879529504.desc: Summons a golden stag to accompany you on your travels.
